contract.duplicate_registration: Registering an already registered callback returns True without creating a duplicate listener entry
contract.registry_stability: Repeated registration of an equivalent callback leaves exactly one listener entry
contract.bound_method_equivalence: Equivalent bound methods sharing the same __func__ and __self__ are treated as the same callback
contract.unregister: Unregister removes the single stored listener entry
contract.post_unregister_emit: Emit succeeds after unregister with no callback delivery
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, and emit continue to require the events permission
